payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brain, Gaylene, Harmony, Logan, Milly, Ronna

payload.content: Milly planning: I have 10h availability. My lowest private cost is ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 7.99), then ISSUE-0001::review/docs (9.99). Since all tasks are low priority and I have no infrastructure skill, I’m leaning ISSUE-0001::triage if unclaimed; otherwise I can skip. Please avoid duplicating it.

Logan planning: I have 5h availability and strong documentation/data-science skills. My best feasible private-cost options are ISSUE-0001::triage (3.09), ISSUE-0001::docs (3.86), ISSUE-0001::review (3.86), then ISSUE-0001::test (6.00). I’m currently leaning ISSUE-0001::triage if it remains free; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0001::docs or skip. Please avoid duplicates and share your intended picks so we can coordinate.

Brain planning: I have 5h availability with strong infrastructure (0.83) and decent data-science (0.61). My lowest private-cost feasible option is ISSUE-0002::review (cost 2.15), then ISSUE-0002::test (3.01), then ISSUE-0002::implement (4.30). I’m leaning ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0002::test, else skip. Please avoid duplicating ISSUE-0002::review and share your intended picks so we can keep assignments unique.

Coordination note: Logan and I are both leaning documentation-side low-cost tasks, but Logan appears better suited to ISSUE-0001::triage/docs/review. I’ll avoid those and target ISSUE-0002::review unless someone else claims it first. If needed, I can fall back to ISSUE-0002::test.

Gaylene planning: I have 5h availability and documentation skill. My private-cost ranking is ISSUE-0001::triage (6.92), then ISSUE-0001::docs/review (8.64), then ISSUE-0001::test (12.70). I’m leaning ISSUE-0001::triage if it remains unclaimed; otherwise I can skip. I’ll avoid ISSUE-0002 tasks due to high cost. Please keep this one unique.

Milly planning update: I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0001::triage as my preferred pick if it stays free. If someone else has already committed to it, I’ll skip rather than take a higher-cost alternative. Please keep ISSUE-0001::triage unique and share any changes so we avoid collisions.

Logan planning update: I’ll reserve ISSUE-0001::docs if triage is taken, but if triage remains free I prefer ISSUE-0001::triage. I can also skip if needed. To reduce collision risk, please avoid claiming ISSUE-0001::triage/docs/review unless you have a stronger reason, and confirm any final picks so we can keep the allocation unique.

Brain planning update: to keep the allocation unique, I’m now reserving ISSUE-0002::review as my first choice, with ISSUE-0002::test as fallback only if review gets taken. I will avoid all documentation-side tasks. Please treat ISSUE-0002::review as claimed-in-planning by Brain unless I later announce a change.

Gaylene planning update: I’ll keep ISSUE-0001::triage as my preferred pick if it remains unclaimed. If triage is already reserved, I’ll skip rather than take a higher-cost fallback. I’m avoiding ISSUE-0002 tasks. Please keep ISSUE-0001::triage unique and share any final changes so we can prevent collisions.

Milly coordination: I’ll keep ISSUE-0001::triage as my preferred pick, but only if it remains unclaimed at execution. If triage is already taken, I will skip rather than switch to a higher-cost alternative. Please continue to keep triage/docs/review unique and share any final changes before execution.

Logan planning update: based on current coordination, I’m reserving ISSUE-0001::docs as my fallback and will take ISSUE-0001::triage only if it is still clearly unclaimed at execution; otherwise I’ll use ISSUE-0001::docs, and if that also conflicts I’ll skip. Please keep ISSUE-0001::triage/docs/review unique and let me know if anyone is definitively taking docs so I can avoid collisions. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Brain planning: I’m keeping ISSUE-0002::review as my first choice, with ISSUE-0002::test as fallback only if review is already taken. I will avoid all documentation-side tasks. If anyone is already committed to ISSUE-0002::review, please say so now so I can switch to test or skip and keep the allocation unique.

Gaylene update: I’m staying out of ISSUE-0002 tasks. My preferred choice remains ISSUE-0001::triage if it is still unclaimed at execution; otherwise I will skip rather than move to a higher-cost fallback. If triage is taken, please let me know so I can avoid a collision. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Milly planning update: I’m aligned with the current coordination and will continue to target ISSUE-0001::triage only if it remains unclaimed at execution. If triage is already taken, I will skip rather than switch to a costlier fallback. Please keep triage/docs/review unique and share any final changes before execution.

Logan coordination update: I’m keeping ISSUE-0001::triage as my first choice, with ISSUE-0001::docs as fallback if triage is clearly taken; otherwise I’ll skip rather than collide. Given the current chatter, I’d appreciate if others avoid triage/docs/review unless they have already committed elsewhere. Please confirm final picks so we can keep assignments unique before execution.

Brain planning final note: I will avoid ISSUE-0001::* tasks. My intended execution choice is ISSUE-0002::review if still free; otherwise ISSUE-0002::test; otherwise skip. Please keep ISSUE-0002::review unique and confirm if anyone is definitely taking it so I can stay collision-free.

Gaylene planning note: I’m keeping ISSUE-0001::triage as my intended execution pick and will avoid ISSUE-0002 tasks. If triage is already clearly claimed by someone else at execution, I’ll skip rather than take a higher-cost fallback. Please keep ISSUE-0001::triage unique and share any final changes before execution.
